parties: Omnivore Agritech & Climate Sustainability Fund 3 (lead), Tur mor consortium (co-investor); Distinct Origins Private Limited (dba Manam Chocolate)
headline: DSK Legal advises Omnivore on $9M investment in Manam Chocolate
sum: Omnivore Fund 3 led a $9 million Series funding into Manam Chocolate, a Hyderabad-based craft chocolate company backed by a network of 250+ cacao farmers, with DSK Legal advising the lead investor on due diligence, documentation and closing.
implication: Early-stage agritech PE deals via thematic funds require comprehensive shareholder and governance documentation (SSA/SHA) given multiple farmer stakeholders and impact-oriented fund mandates; DSK's end-to-end involvement (due diligence through secretarial closing) reflects standard mid-market PE practice.
detail: Manam Chocolate, founded in 2021 by Chaitanya Muppala, operates a direct-to-farmer cacao procurement model, managing 3,000+ acres across 250 farmer partners in the agritech/food-and-agri subsector. Omnivore Fund 3, a dedicated agritech and climate-sustainability vehicle, led the round with co-investment from Tur mor consortium. DSK Legal's transaction scope included full due diligence, Share Subscription Agreement drafting, Shareholders' Agreement, conditions precedent documentation and secretarial services for closing.
